item.title: From 34% to 96%: The Porting Initiative Delivers – Hologram v0.7.0
item.description:
📝 With 150 newly ported Erlang functions, Erlang runtime coverage has jumped from 34% to 96% - and overall Elixir standard library readiness has grown from 74% to 87%. This means the vast majority of Elixir standard library functions needed for Phase 1 (full-stack web and basic local-first apps) now work in the browser. Functions for string manipulation, collections, math, sets, binary operations, Unicode normalization, file path handling, time operations, and more - all available client-side.
🔗 Read more: https://hologram.page/blog/porting-initiative-delivers-hologram-v0-7-0
